title: Engine specification: universal two-letter kernels and D_1 on all local operators (R8)

conventions.manuscript: Ch1 (fields, action, Q), Ch3 (Q^GF, K_t, P(eps,T)), Ch4 (I^CT, unit, 27/16), Ch5 (O(eps)), Ch6 (dilatation), Ch8 (Def c8-quant, def:c8-renorm, components), Ch9 (composite kernel, D_1, P_1)
conventions.regulator: per-edge Schwinger cutoff t_e >= eps on every edge P(eps,T); T = infinity (generic momenta) or finite T (any momenta): counterterms identical (Prop prop:tl-map (iii)); NO dimensional regularisation
conventions.unit: hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2) for su(N), (X,Y) = -(4 hbar/g^2) tr(XY)
conventions.two_component: Def c8-twocomp; step2/notation/dictionary.json; every reported kernel also in components

definitions.counterterm_map: d_delta I^CT[eps](M) = sum_m eps^-m ct_m(M) + log eps lc(M) = hbar Sing_eps d_{P_e} M (Thm thm:tl-decomp)
definitions.two_letter_kernel: K_eps(X_a,X_b) = hbar Sing_eps [(d^alpha (x) d^beta) P_e^{ab}(x,y)]_{y=x}, P_e = sum_k P (I_e P)^k
definitions.signs: sigma_ab = (-1)^{|X_b|(|X_{a+1}|+...+|X_{b-1}|)}; component of P in the order (a,b) (Def c3-P)
definitions.colour: (1 (x) w)(-,-)^{-1}, w = ad_{Y_r}...ad_{Y_1} (Y_1 nearest X_a); su(N) single trace: adjacent -> (-1)^r N tr(M Y_1..Y_r) + multi-trace; general position -> multi-trace only; across traces -> merged trace tr(M1 Y_{S^c}^-> M2 Y_S^<-), no N; wrap-around pair (X_1,X_n) -> +N tr(X_2..X_{n-1} Y_r..Y_1) (Lemma lem:tl-colour)
definitions.lc_natural: lc(M) - u {2 int(A,A*) - 4 int(lambda*,lambda) - int(c*,c), M}; commutes with s = Q + {I,-}
definitions.D1: D_1 = 4 lc^natural - {F_Delta prime, -} + C_Delta  (Thm thm:tl-D1); F_Delta prime with theta_perp, theta_lambda, theta_V, kappa_V, kappa_lambda (Def def:tl-H)
